title: Expected Outcomes for Energy-Flow Cosmology Cross-Survey Invariance and BIG-SPARC Tests
description: Pre-data working note estimating expected outcomes for the pre-registered Energy-Flow Cosmology (EFC) cross-survey invariance tests (P1–P8). Using the SPARC-175 Kill-Test v6 baseline and structural AIC/BIC analysis, it projects Tier-1 (THINGS, LITTLE THINGS) and Tier-2 (WALLABY DR2) win rates, overlap consistency, regime fractions, and the likely role of BIG-SPARC as the decisive tiebreaker. The most probable result is partial support (Scenario B), with modest AIC/BIC win rates and robust overlap on decisive cases.

delta_AIC.description: Information criterion used for model comparison; penalizes additional parameters with a constant factor of 2 per parameter.

delta_BIC.description: Stronger penalty than AIC for model complexity; here N is the number of data points in the fit.

extra_penalty_per_galaxy.description: Approximate additional per-galaxy penalty BIC applies relative to AIC given the number of rotation-curve points.

win_rate.description: Win rate: fraction of galaxies where EFC is preferred over the comparator under a given criterion (AIC/BIC).

key_results.main_finding: Pre-data projection favors Scenario B (partial support): Tier-1 AIC WR ≈ 58% (BIC ≈ 53%), WALLABY AIC WR ≈ 43% (BIC ≈ 35%), overlap consistency 10–12/14, with decisive SPARC wins expected to remain robust; BIG-SPARC is anticipated to be the decisive tiebreaker.
parameters_tested: AIC vs BIC model selection penalty

sealed_predictions.statement: Cross-survey k invariance (proxied by Tier-1 non-SPARC AIC win rate) holds with WR > 55% and BIC remaining above 50%.
sealed_predictions.falsifiable_by: Compute WR on THINGS+LITTLE THINGS per preregistered pipeline; if AIC WR ≤ 55% or BIC WR ≤ 50% with Wilson 95% CI not overlapping thresholds, prediction fails.

sealed_predictions.statement: Overlap consistency: for the 14 SPARC–THINGS galaxies, the model-preference sign and strength agree in ≥ 10/14, with decisive cases showing |ΔAIC_SP−ΔAIC_TH| < 3.
sealed_predictions.falsifiable_by: Count consistent outcomes; if < 10/14 or systematic flips of decisive cases occur, prediction fails.

sealed_predictions.statement: Regime fractions (FLOW / TRANSITION / LATENT) in Tier-1 match SPARC baseline within ±15 percentage points.
sealed_predictions.falsifiable_by: Estimate regime fractions via χ2-ratio proxy; if any regime deviates by > 15 pp from SPARC baseline (41.5%, 49.1%, 9.4%), prediction fails.

sealed_predictions.statement: WALLABY DR2 AIC win rate for EFC is ≥ 45%.
sealed_predictions.falsifiable_by: Compute AIC WR on WALLABY DR2; if WR < 45% with Wilson 95% CI upper bound ≤ 45%, prediction fails.

sealed_predictions.statement: BIG-SPARC yields k_BIG = 0.415 ± 0.015, consistent with the SPARC baseline (k = 0.415 ± 0.029) within 3σ.
sealed_predictions.falsifiable_by: Fit k on BIG-SPARC; if |k_BIG − 0.415| > 3σ_combined, prediction fails.

sealed_predictions.statement: BIG-SPARC global win rate is ≥ 50% (AIC and corroborated by BIC).
sealed_predictions.falsifiable_by: Compute AIC/BIC WR on BIG-SPARC; if both metrics yield WR < 50% with Wilson 95% CI upper ≤ 50%, prediction fails.

sealed_predictions.statement: FLOW-regime galaxies in BIG-SPARC show WR ≥ 85%.
sealed_predictions.falsifiable_by: Stratify BIG-SPARC by regime; if FLOW WR < 85% with Wilson 95% CI lower < 85%, prediction fails.

sealed_predictions.statement: No secondary dependence of k on galaxy properties (e.g., mass, size, gas fraction) at > 3σ significance.
sealed_predictions.falsifiable_by: Regression or hierarchical modeling on BIG-SPARC; detection of > 3σ correlation between k and secondary properties falsifies.

kill_criteria: KC1: Tier-1 non-SPARC cross-survey invariance fails decisively: AIC and BIC WR both < 50% with Wilson 95% CI upper bounds ≤ 50%, and overlap consistency < 7/14.
KC2: BIG-SPARC screening parameter estimate inconsistent with SPARC baseline at > 3σ: |k_BIG − 0.415| > 3σ_combined or k_BIG outside 0.415 ± 0.045.
KC3: BIG-SPARC global performance fail: AIC and BIC WR both < 50% with Wilson 95% CI upper bounds ≤ 50%.
KC4: FLOW-regime failure on BIG-SPARC: FLOW WR < 85% with Wilson 95% CI lower bound < 85%.
KC5: Regime-fraction inconsistency: Any of FLOW/TRANSITION/LATENT fractions deviate by more than ±15 percentage points from SPARC baseline in Tier-1 or BIG-SPARC.
KC6: Robust evidence of secondary dependence: Detection at > 3σ of k varying systematically with galaxy properties (mass, size, surface brightness, gas fraction), contradicting invariance.

related_packages.role: Baseline calibration for universality and decisive/marginal win characterization used in projections
